summary: GMEX Robotics, a BVI-incorporated Australian-based foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing a Preferred Share Conversion Inducement Agreement dated October 20, 2026, with holders of its Class C preferred. This follows its October 14, 2026 consummation of a share purchase agreement to acquire 30% of Alpha Meta AI Pte. Ltd. for US$2.52 million, 15% cash and 85% in Class C preferred. Holders will convert 2,142 preferred at 23% of prior-day closing price into 10,961,680 Class A ordinary shares, plus 1,500 additional Class C shares as inducement, issued under Section 4(a)(2)/3(a)(9) exemptions. Watch dilution and overhang.
